column1: # Written for a build that reads storage schema versions 1..=2 (current = 2).
# stored       : version under `stor_ver` before the call
# steps        : number of plan steps (0 makes the plan invalid)
# journal      : none | in_progress | failed | completed (a run of exactly this plan)
#                | completed_other (a completed run of the same source but to_version + 1)
# caller       : admin | stranger (an address that is not the contract admin)
# stored_after : version under `stor_ver` after the commit attempt
